Package game.items

Class Fire

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.Fire
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable
public class Fire extends Item
Fire lying on the ground. It cannot be picked up, burns for a limited number of turns and, on every turn of its life, burns whoever is standing on its tile. Because the burn is reapplied every turn, an Actor who stays in the fire keeps burning for as long as the fire lasts.

How long the fire lasts, and how hard it burns, are supplied by whatever lights it (a teleportation circle, an exploding geode, ...).
